description: This Java class 'JwtService' provides functionality for issuing and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). It includes methods to generate access tokens with subject and roles, and to parse and validate incoming tokens. It interacts with configuration properties for JWT settings and uses the io.jsonwebtoken library for token operations.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: Service for JWT issuing and verification, responsible for generating and parsing JWT tokens.

methods.name: generateAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token for the given subject and roles.

methods.name: parseAndValidate
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT. Throws a runtime exception on invalid token.
